'''Shockmitts''',<ref name="Fists of Iron">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20081031.html|text="Fists of Ion"|int=Fists of Ion|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref> also known as '''shockboxing gloves''', were a type of powered [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]], similar to [[stun gauntlet]]s, used for the sport of [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxing]]. Designed to both protect the [[Limb/Legends|hands]] of the wearer and deal damage to an opponent, shockboxing [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] emitted electricity with every blow or grab. Unlike [[Stunner/Legends|stun]] gauntlets, shockboxing gloves had variable levels of electrical outputs that ranged from a stun setting, to a light shock as often used during sparring sessions, all the way to a [[Death/Legends|lethal]] output. The way shockboxing gloves were worn kept the gloves from falling from the wearer's hands and prevented forceful disarmament. They weighed approximately 0.4 to 0.5 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] on average, and ran around five to six hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in price.<ref name="GaW" />
